title: gpt-image-2
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Primary request: A warm editorial illustration in hand-drawn pencil sketch style with light watercolor washes on a clean white background. A human writer and a small friendly robot collaborating at a desk, with notes, timeline, and storyboard panels. Isometric-ish layout, left-to-right creative workflow. Muted pastel accents: soft blue, sage green, terracotta orange, lavender. Graphite line work. Thoughtful, airy, human-AI collaboration mood.
Style/medium: hand-drawn pencil sketch, ink line art, light watercolor washes, sketchbook aesthetic
Composition/framing: isometric-ish layout, left-to-right workflow, desk as central stage
Lighting/mood: soft even daylight, no harsh shadows
Color palette: white paper, graphite gray lines, soft blue, sage green, terracotta orange, lavender
Constraints: clean white background, no photorealism, no 3D render look
Avoid: dark background, neon colors, heavy shadows, photorealism, 3D render
